top.title: Etihad Rail Al Dhaid station opens: ‘Best option’ for Abu Dhabi trips, say passengers
top.teaser: Al Dhaid joined the UAE’s national passenger railway on Wednesday, giving Sharjah its first Etihad Rail station and connecting the emirate to Fujairah and Abu Dhabi. The new station in Muragabat serves as a rail gateway for central Sharjah and nearby communities, including Shawka. top.headline: Al Dhaid opens Sharjah's first Etihad Rail station
top.summary: Sharjah's first Etihad Rail passenger station has officially opened in Al Dhaid. It connects central communities to Abu Dhabi and Fujairah.
top.why: New transport links boost regional accessibility and property appeal in outer areas.

top.title: Dubai developers hold off-plan prices steady as only 6% cut prices by 5% or more since February
top.teaser: Developers in Dubai have largely held off-plan prices steady through 2026 as sales volumes and absorption rates adjust, according to fäm Properties. 44 of the 717 off-plan projects launched since July 2023 have reduced prices by 5 per cent or more since the end of February, while only 28 projects, or 4 per cent, are currently selling below their original launch price, as per the market analysis. top.headline: Dubai developers keep off-plan prices mostly stable

top.headline: Aldar and Arada team up for Dh15 billion Abu Dhabi projects
